detail.longDescription: 📢 Help us improve the Haven+ CIS Kubernetes Evidence Guide! I've drafted a guide that maps the CIS Kubernetes Benchmark to practical roles, implementation controls, and audit evidence within Haven+. Looking for community reviewers! Are you a platform/security engineer, auditor, or service manager? Please share your feedback on its practical usability.
